# pcd_networking_secgroup (Data Source)

Look up a Neutron security group by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_networking_secgroup" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-secgroup"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Look up by name.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `secgroup_id` (String) Look up by ID (takes precedence over name).
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the owning project.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description.
- `id` (String) The security group ID.
